    feat: add NMD land cover analyzer with DES fetch and cross-referencing
    
    Integrate Nationellt Marktäckedata (NMD) from Digital Earth Sweden to
    provide land cover context for all other analyzers. The NMD analyzer
    cross-references spectral, change detection and object detection results
    with LULC classes (forest, open land, developed, water) at two detail
    levels. Includes NMD data fetching via openEO with local file caching,
    SCL-based cloud masking, and date window search for Sentinel-2 data.

commit df45803a5851dd9fe440d086ca9da8aa0ac28d13
Author:     Tobias Edman <tobias@modinedman.se>

Commit:     Tobias Edman <tobias@modinedman.se>
CommitDate: Wed Aug 5 21:58:24 2026 +0200

    feat(schema): NMD2023 → unified 29-class mapping (retrain step 1)
    
    First executable step of the NMD2023 label-source retrain
    (docs/experiments/nmd2023_label_source_retrain.md): the schema + mapping that
    lets build_labels emit NMD2023-based labels.
    
    Why: NMD2023's basskikt codes differ from NMD2018 for open land (4-digit codes
    > uint8) and carry structure detail NMD2018 has no codes for. The existing
    uint8 nmd_raster_to_lulc LUT silently clips those to background, so a dedicated
    mapping is required.
    
    How:
    - Schema grows 23 → 29. Six NMD2023-only classes: 23 torvtäkt, 24/25/26
      busk/ris/gräs-dominated open land, 27 bare open land, 28 snö/is (glacier +
      snowfield merged). Moisture level (torr/frisk/frisk-fuktig) collapsed — it is
      DEM-derived, not spectral.
    - nmd2023_to_unified(): direct raw-uint16 → unified LUT. Forest codes 111-128
      resolve to the SAME unified classes as NMD2018 so a v8b finetune keeps a
      consistent forest label space; only the open-land/peat/snow detail is new.
      Out-of-range / no-data (raster 0) → background.
    - k8s: the per-plot v8b eval job (produced the committed benchmark dump) and the
      one-off cephfs-cleanup pod (freed the 520G pre-recoreg backup) recorded for
      reproducibility.
    
    Not in this commit: build_labels wiring, the label rebuild run, and the model
    head expansion 23 → 29 — the next steps in the plan.
    
    Verified-by: pytest tests/test_schema.py -q — 27 passed
    Verified-by: nmd2023_to_unified on a real 2000² NMD2023 window — 48 codes, 0 unmapped, classes 0-27 sane
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

    feat(distill): NFI-head distillation — final head + dense pseudo-label script
    
    Distill the field-truth-calibrated head into the dense model. Honest-eval
    protocol: grouped 80/20 tile split (208 train tiles / 735 plots vs 53 test
    tiles / 209 plots, no tile straddles); the final head is trained on the TRAIN
    side only, so the test-tile plots stay untouched for the end-to-end eval of the
    distilled seg model.
    
    - train_distill_head.py: grouped split, scaler+MLP(128,) on train plots,
      exported as a dependency-free npz (numpy forward asserted == sklearn .predict
      on all 944). Head-only preview on held-out test plots: 0.6172 (+0.124 over
      NMD2023 0.493) — consistent with the leak-free OOF 0.632-0.637.
    - distill_forest_labels.py: dense head forward over every tile (hook + bilinear
      upsample, same geometry as extract_plot_features), conservative override of
      the NMD2023 label sidecars — a pixel changes iff original label AND head pred
      are both in {tall,gran,löv,bland}; everything else keeps the original label.
      Border ring (512→504 crop) preserved. Atomic writes, skip-existing.
    - data/distill/{distill_head.npz,distill_split.json} (143 KB, force-added past
      the data/ ignore) — the job's git-clone ships them to the cluster.
    
    Verified-by: npz forward == sklearn .predict on 944 plots (asserted)
    Verified-by: synthetic D2 end-to-end — offset placement, border ring, override truth-table, key preservation
    Verified-by: pytest test_validate_against_nfi test_schema — 32 passed
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
